name: Traction Energy Consumption
description: Energy consumption of a train on a given route. Checks whether energy budget and grid substation capacity are respected.

elements.name: Specific Energy Consumption
elements.description: Energy drawn from catenary per kilometre. Uncertain due to passenger load and driving style.

uncertainty.source: Fleet energy monitoring data over 6 months

elements.name: Contracted Maximum Specific Energy
elements.description: Maximum specific energy per traction power contract with grid operator

consistency_relations.upr_description: Specific energy consumption is transferred directly (identity mapping) to the contract compliance check domain. No unit conversion or scaling is required — the measured kWh/km directly corresponds to the contracted limit, and the uncertainty set must remain within the 35 kWh/km threshold.
